rfqRoute: A buyer searching for mailer cartons or cardboard mailers usually needs a shipping-ready structure, not only a visual box style.
The RFQ should define internal size, product weight, flute or paperboard direction, closure style, printing area, insert or void-fill need, shipping channel and quantity range.
Plain mailer boxes can still require different material and structure choices depending on product fragility, parcel handling and whether the box is also used as retail presentation packaging.
MUGE PACKAGING should route these searches to a quote checklist before asking buyers to compare price, so the factory review starts from dimensions, structure and use case.
After publishing, this segment should be checked against Ads search terms, GA4 key events and GSC query/page movement before any bid or landing page decision.
